item.title: In the garden: Now is the time to start transplants
item.description: Even if your doctor hasn’t told you to eat more greens for your health it’s still a great idea! Growing lettuce is a fun garden crop to plant because it grows fairly quick. Though lettuce is most often planted directly from seed in late March to early April, it can be started from transplants. Transplants allow lettuce to mature earlier so that it escapes the excessive heat that can lead to a strong flavor and bitterness.

item.title: Spring into Seasonal Allergies
item.description: The groundhog may have seen his shadow, but Spring will be here soon. While many of us look forward to warmer days and blooming flowers, those who suffer from seasonal allergies know that the return of grass, budding trees, and blooming flowers can lead to more sneezing than smiles. Welcome to the Spring allergy season.

item.title: Harvey County Sheriff’s Office seeks more female deputies to maintain safety, compliance at detention center
item.description: With female deputies absent from 30 detention center shifts last month, the Harvey County Sheriff’s Office says it urgently needs more women on staff — a move that would help protect female inmates and keep the jail in compliance with federal safety standards.

item.title: In arresting and prosecuting journalists, Trump administration draws from authoritarian playbook
item.description: Like many Americans, I am deeply concerned about the Trump regime’s unhinged and unchecked authoritarian tactics. U.S. Immigration and Enforcement agents killing peaceful protestors on the street. Officials threatening lawyers and universities. Now, the administration is going after journalists who report the news.

item.title: Is $8.3 million justice in the death of Kansas teenager? Can repeat cases be prevented?
item.description: A Sedgwick County federal court jury recently awarded C.J. Lofton’s family $8.3 million in compensation for Lofton’s death at the hands of juvenile intake officers. They held Lofton facedown for more than 30 minutes, killing him.
